mapper.sql: select device_id, monitoring, status, last_change_at, update_time from scene_probe_state
mapper.select:
select p.device_id, p.monitoring, p.status, p.last_change_at, p.update_time from scene_probe_state p inner join scene_device d on d.device_id = p.device_id and d.del_flag = '0'
AND d.building_id = #{buildingId}

select p.device_id, p.monitoring, p.status, p.last_change_at, p.update_time from scene_probe_state p inner join scene_device d on d.device_id = p.device_id and d.del_flag = '0' where p.monitoring = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into scene_probe_state( device_id, monitoring, status, last_change_at, update_time )values( #{deviceId}, #{monitoringFlag}, #{status}, #{lastChangeAt}, sysdate() )
